title: Ethnicity Themed Restaurants?
content: The other night I dreamt of being in some sort of small downtown area at night with snow on the ground. There were shops lit up with lights in the windows, literally named after countries or ethnicities. The random ones here and there I remember are: Estonia, Russia, Latvia, Kazakhstan, India. Odd because I've never been to these places before irl. The "restaurants/shops" in the dream were nondescript on the outside. I just remember being in the general crowd and everyone was coming and going seemingly in confusion.
